fields.FIR_Description: During the morning of 2026-07-11, around 09:25, the complainant found the pocket emptied of cash (about Rs. 4,500) after boarding a crowded bus near Oviya Colony Railway Station Road in Erode, according to the complaint recorded on 2026-07-11. Suspicion was reportedly directed towards Sanjay Palanisamy, using the number 9000000215. Dinesh Balan (9000000363), described as an intermediary, was also mentioned in the complaint. Items referenced in the complaint: CCTV footage. Records suggest a possible link with FIR-2026-00447, as the mobile number 9000000215 is associated with a suspect in both entries.
fields.Modus_Operandi: Wallet allegedly lifted from a pocket in a crowded queue.
